packs.name: Meadow
packs.blurb: Hop from tile to tile. Every tile is visited once.

packs.name: Creek
packs.blurb: Gaps appear. Jump over one missing tile.

packs.name: Gully
packs.blurb: Some tiles crack: they need two visits.

packs.name: Billabong
packs.blurb: Open water in the middle. Plan the way round.

packs.name: Ridge
packs.blurb: Long runs that fold back on themselves.

packs.name: Plateau
packs.blurb: Everything at once, on a big board.
